description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location in Vancouver, BC, part of the global coffeehouse chain that originated in Seattle in 1971. Starbucks offers a wide range of espresso drinks, refreshers, teas, and food items including sandwiches. Touring cyclists will find it a familiar rest stop, though specific in-store amenities vary by location.
